title: Permissions Inspector: role-focused access review and granular assignment UI
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a compact, review-first UI called the Permissions Inspector that helps admins audit role capabilities, preview effective permissions for specific users/groups, and perform bulk or one-off member assignments. The flow must surface audit log links, SSO group mappings, and allow safe previews of changes (impact simulation) before commit. This ticket covers wireframes, microcopy, interaction states (error, pending change, audit mismatch), and an accessibility pass.
acceptance_criteria: Wireframes for the Permissions Inspector panel (left rail list + main detail canvas) in Figma with annotated states
Component spec for permissions matrix rows, inline role badges, and 'Preview impact' modal
Microcopy for confirmation dialogs and audit links reviewed by security and legal
Handoff package including tokens, accessibility checklist (WCAG AA), and CSS-ready spacing/typography
Prototype showing simulated role changes and reflected audit-log links (no backend required)
engineering_dependencies: ENG-2437: Audit-log deep linking and time-range filters
ENG-2470: SSO group sync delta metadata

decisions: Use a preview modal that computes 'effective changes' and lists affected resources before commit
Display SSO group mappings inline next to role members with a small badge and hover detail
Expose an 'audit link' per change that opens the audit timeline filtered to the relevant resource, actor, and time window
Introduce three safety states for assignment actions: "Previewed", "Pending approval", and "Applied" (Pending approval used when org policy requires)
